.lineup-panel{position:sticky;top:18px;padding:16px;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}.audience-reach-panel{margin-top:16px;background:var(--paper);border:2px solid var(--ink);padding:16px;box-shadow:5px 6px 0 rgba(21,20,18,.08)}.audience-reach-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:baseline}.audience-reach-head strong{font-size:16px}.audience-state{font-weight:900;color:var(--accent);font-size:14px}.audience-meter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;margin:11px 0}.audience-meter span{height:7px;background:#d8cdbd}.audience-meter span.on{background:var(--accent)}.audience-reaction{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 10px;background:#f6efe2;border-left:4px solid var(--city-accent);margin:8px 0 12px}.booked-genres{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px}.booked-genres-title{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px}.booked-genre-row{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;margin:5px 0}.booked-genre-row strong{font-size:11px}.genre-pill{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:3px 5px;margin:2px 2px 0 0;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;background:var(--paper2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
